mapper.select: /** * selectIcbtgAltmntList : isry.couns.mngr.icbtgmng.mapper.IcbtgAltmntMapper : 인큐베이팅 상담자배정표 조회 */ SELECT substr(T1.INCUBA_WORK_YMD, 0, 6) AS CRTR_YM /* 인큐베이팅 근무연월 */ , T1.INCUBA_WORK_YMD AS WORK_YMD /* 인큐베이팅 근무일자 */ , T1.CONSTT_ID AS CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담원 아이디 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(T3.FLNM_ENCPT) AS CNSLTNT_NM /* 상담원 이름 */ , T1.NTABRD_EVL_YN AS NTABRD_EVL_YN /* 게시판 평가 여부 */ , T1.CHTT_EVL_YN AS CHTT_EVL_YN /* 채팅 평가 여부 */ , T1.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN /* 일련번호 */ FROM AYC150 T1 /* 근무배정표_인큐베이팅 */ , SAA200 T2 /* 사용자 */ , SCA100 T3 /* 종사자 */ WHERE 1=1 AND T1.CONSTT_ID = T2.USER_ID AND T2.ENFSN_NO = T3.ENFSN_NO AND T1.INCUBA_WORK_YMD LIKE #{CRTR_YM}||'%' AND T3.OGDP_DEPT_CD = #{DEPT_CD}
mapper.insert: /** * insertIcbtgAltmnt : isry.couns.mngr.icbtgmng.mapper.insertIcbtgAltmnt : 인큐베이팅 상담자배정표 등록 */ INSERT INTO AYC150 ( INDEX_SN , CONSTT_ID , NTABRD_EVL_YN , CHTT_EVL_YN , INCUBA_WORK_YMD ) SELECT AYC150_SQ01.NEXTVAL , BB.CONSTT_ID , BB.NTABRD_EVL_YN , BB.CHTT_EVL_YN , TO_CHAR(AA.INCUBA_WORK_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD') FROM ( SELECT TRUNC(TO_DATE(#{START_DT}, 'YYYYMMDD') + (LEVEL - 1)) AS INCUBA_WORK_YMD FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT}, 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(#{START_DT}, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1 ) AA , ( SELECT #{CONSTT_ID} AS CONSTT_ID , #{NTABRD_EVL_YN} AS NTABRD_EVL_YN , #{CHTT_EVL_YN} AS CHTT_EVL_YN FROM DUAL ) BB
mapper.select: /** * selectIcbtgAltmntYmdCheckList : isry.couns.mngr.icbtgmng.mapper.selectIcbtgAltmntYmdCheckList : 인큐베이팅 관리 중복된 날짜를 조회 */ SELECT T1.INCUBA_WORK_YMD FROM AYC150 T1 WHERE 1 = 1 AND TO_DATE(#{START_DT}, 'YYYYMMDD') <= TO_DATE(T1.INCUBA_WORK_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(T1.INCUBA_WORK_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD') <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND T1.CONSTT_ID = #{CONSTT_ID}
